purpose: Descriptive long-history characterization of the two strongest candidates from the 2026-09-12 research day. This is intentionally post-selection and is not an independent OOS validation.

selection_rationale.R6B-347: Strongest combined 2024-2025 pre-OOS profitability plus strongest Jan-Aug 2026 STRESS net among the positive R6 survivors tested today.
selection_rationale.R6B-307: Best Jan-Aug 2026 E1 profit factor among the positive R6 survivors, positive STRESS, positive ex-best-trade result, and materially less H2 deterioration than the highest-net siblings.

market_source.export_method: read-only MetaTrader5 Python copy_rates_range in monthly chunks
canonical_overlap_checks: 2024-2025 overlap must reconcile with frozen Phase I-B raw datasets
2026 Jan-Jul overlap must reconcile with frozen Phase I-F snapshots

source_variants.RAW_FULL_HISTORY: Raw M5 signal source for the complete 2017-Jul2026 interval; raw M1 execution.
source_variants.HYBRID_CANONICAL: 2017-2023 raw M5; exact frozen +/-5 minute high-impact USD masking for 2024-2025 and Jan-Jul 2026; raw M1 execution. Historical 2017-2023 calendar masking is unavailable in the current frozen lab and is therefore not invented.

execution.entry: first raw-M1 open at or after signal bar close
execution.exit: first raw-M1 open at frozen M5 horizon boundary
execution.overlap: one position at a time per candidate; exit before equal-timestamp new entry

required_outputs: positive-year ratios under E1 and STRESS
candidate monthly-PnL correlation and simple combined diagnostic
interpretation: A strong long-history result may justify building a prototype EA for controlled forward/live evaluation on a user-approved account. It does not become new independent validation because the candidates were selected before this retrospective scan. No live deployment is authorized by this job.
